H1600.def: a primitive root; to bellow (as cattle):--low.

H1601.def: feminine active participle of «01600»; lowing; Goah, a place near Jerusalem:--Goath.

H1602.def: a primitive root; to detest; by implication, to reject:--abhor, fail, lothe, vilely cast away.

H1605.def: a primitive root; to chide:--corrupt, rebuke, reprove.

H1607.def: a primitive root to agitate violently:--move, shake, toss, trouble.

H1608.def: from «01607»; a quaking; Gaash, a hill in Palestine:--Gaash.

H1609.def: of uncertain derivation; Gatam, an Edomite:--Gatam.

H1610.et: from an unused root meaning to arch
H1610.def: from an unused root meaning to arch; the back; by extensive the body or self:--+ highest places, himself.

H1612.et: from an unused root meaning to bend
H1612.def: from an unused root meaning to bend; a vine (as twining), especially the grape:--vine, tree.

H1613.et: from an unused root, probably meaning to house in
H1613.def: from an unused root, probably meaning to house in; a kind of tree or wood (as used for building), apparently the cypress:-- gopher.

H1614.def: probably feminine of «01613»; properly, cypress- resin; by analogy, sulphur (as equally inflammable):--brimstone.

H1615.def: perhaps from «03564»; lime (from being burned in a kiln):--chalk(-stone).

H1616.def: or (fully) geyr (gare); from «01481»; properly, a guest; by implication, a foreigner:--alien, sojourner, stranger.

H1617.def: perhaps from «01626»; a grain; Gera, the name of six Israelites:--Gera.

H1618.et: from an unused root meaning to scratch
H1618.def: from an unused root meaning to scratch; scurf (from itching):--scab, scurvy.

H1619.def: from the same as «01618»; scabby; Gareb, the name of an Israelite, also of a hill near Jerusalem:--Gareb.

H1620.def: by reduplication from «01641»; a berry (as if a pellet of rumination):--berry.

H1621.def: feminine plural from «01641»; the throat (as used in rumination):--neck.

H1622.et: patrial from an unused name [of uncertain derivation]
H1622.def: patrial from an unused name (of uncertain derivation); a Girgashite, one of the native tribes of Canaan:--Girgashite, Girgasite.

H1624.def: a primitive root; properly, to grate, i.e. (figuratively) to anger:--contend, meddle, stir up, strive.

H1625.def: from «01641»; the cud (as scraping the throat):--cud.

H1626.def: from «01641» (as in «01625»); properly, (like «01620») a kernel (round as if scraped), i.e. a gerah or small weight (and coin):-- gerah.

H1627.def: or (shortened) garon {gaw-rone'}; from «01641»; the throat (compare «01621») (as roughened by swallowing):--X aloud, mouth, neck, throat.

H1629.def: a primitive root; to cut off:--cut off.

H1630.et: plural of an unused noun from (01629)
H1630.def: plural of an unused noun from «01629» (compare «01511»), cut up (i.e. rocky); Gerizim, a mountain of Palestine:--Gerizim.

H1632.def: from the same as «01486»; harsh:--man of great (as in the margin which reads «01419»).

H1633.def: a primitive root; to be spare or skeleton-like; used only as a denominative from «01634»; (causative) to bone, i.e. denude (by extensive, craunch) the bones:--gnaw the bones, break.

H1634.def: from «01633»; a bone (as the skeleton of the body); hence, self, i.e. (figuratively) very:--bone, strong, top.

H1637.et: from an unused root meaning to smooth
H1637.def: from an unused root meaning to smooth; a threshing- floor (as made even); by analogy, any open area:--(barn, corn, threshing- )floor, (threshing-, void) place.

H1638.def: a primitive root; to crush; also (intransitively and figuratively) to dissolve:--break.

H1639.def: a primitive root; to scrape off; by implication, to shave, remove, lessen, withhold:--abate, clip, (di-)minish, do (take) away, keep back, restrain, make small, withdraw.

H1640.def: a primitive root; to bear off violently:--sweep away.

H1641.def: a primitive root; to drag off roughly; by implication, to bring up the cud (i.e. ruminate); by analogy, to saw:--catch, chew, × continuing, destroy, saw.

H1642.def: probably from «01641»; a rolling country; Gerar, a Philistine city:--Gerar.

H1643.et: from an unused root meaning to husk
H1643.def: from an unused root meaning to husk; a kernel (collectively), i.e. grain:--beaten corn.

H1644.def: a primitive root; to drive out from a possession; especially to expatriate or divorce:--cast up (out), divorced (woman), drive away (forth, out), expel, × surely put away, trouble, thrust out.

H1647.def: for «01648»; Gereshom, the name of four Israelites:--Gershom.

H1648.def: or Gershowm {gay-resh-ome'}; from «01644»; a refugee; Gereshon or Gereshom, an Israelite:--Gershon, Gershom.

H1649.def: patronymically from «01648»; a Gereshonite or descendant of Gereshon:--Gershonite, sons of Gershon.

H1650.et: from an unused root (meaning to join)
H1650.def: from an unused root (meaning to join); bridge; Geshur, a district of Syria:--Geshur, Geshurite.

H1651.def: patrial from «01650»; a Geshurite (also collectively) or inhabitants of Geshur:--Geshuri, Geshurites.

H1652.def: a primitive root; to shower violently:--(cause to) rain.

H1654.def: or (prolonged) Gashmuw {gash-moo'}; the same as «01653»; Geshem or Gashmu, an Arabian:--Geshem, Gashmu.

H1655.def: (Aramaic) apparently the same as «01653»; used in a peculiar sense, the body (probably for the (figuratively) idea of a hard rain):--body.

H1657.def: probably of Egyptian origin; Goshen, the residence of the Israelites in Egypt; also a place in Palestine:--Goshen.

H1658.def: of uncertain derivation; Gishpa, an Israelite:--Gispa.

H1659.def: a primitive root; apparently to feel about:--grope.

H1660.et: probably from (05059) (sense of treading out grapes)
H1660.def: probably from «05059» (in the sense of treading out grapes); a wine-press (or vat for holding the grapes in pressing them):-- (wine-)press (fat).

H1661.def: the same as «01660»; Gath, a Philistine city:--Gath.

H1662.et: from (01660) and (02658) with the article inserted
H1662.def: or (abridged) Gittah-Chepher {ghit-taw-khay'-fer}; from 1660 and «02658» with the article inserted; wine- press of (the) well; Gath-Chepher, a place in Palestine:--Gath-kephr, Gittah-kephr.

H1663.def: patrial from «01661»; a Gittite or inhabitant of Gath:--Gittite.

H1664.def: dual of «01660»; double wine-press; Gittajim, a place in Palestine:--Gittaim.

H1666.def: of uncertain derivation; Gether, a son of Aram, and the region settled by him:--Gether.

H1667.def: from «01660» and «07416»; wine-press of (the) pomegranate; Gath-Rimmon, a place in Palestine:--Gath-rimmon.

H1669.def: a primitive root; to pine:--mourn, sorrow(-ful).

H1670.def: from «01669»; properly, pining; by analogy, fear:--sorrow.

H1672.def: a primitive root; be anxious:--be afraid (careful, sorry), sorrow, take thought.

H1673.def: or (fully) Dowoeg {do-ayg'}; active participle of «01672»; anxious; Doeg, an Edomite:--Doeg.

H1675.def: a primitive root; to dart, i.e. fly rapidly:--fly.

H1676.def: from «01675»; the kite (from its rapid flight):--vulture. See «07201».

H1677.def: or (fully) dowb {dobe}; from «01680»; the bear (as slow):-- bear.

H1679.def: from an unused root (compare «01680») (probably meaning to be sluggish, i.e. restful); quiet:--strength.

H1680.def: a primitive root (compare «01679»); to move slowly, i.e. glide:--cause to speak.

H1681.et: from (01680) (in the sense of furtive motion)
H1681.def: from «01680» (in the sense of furtive motion); slander:--defaming, evil report, infamy, slander.

H1682.et: from (01696) (in the sense of orderly motion)
H1682.def: or (shortened) dborah {deb-o-raw'}; from «01696» (in the sense of orderly motion); the bee (from its systematic instincts):--bee.

H1683.def: or (shortened) Dborah {deb-o-raw'}; the same as «01682»; Deborah, the name of two Hebrewesses:--Deborah.

H1686.et: both (in the pl. only and) of uncertain derivation
H1686.def: in the margin for the textual reading, cheryown {kher-yone'}; both (in the plural only and) of uncertain derivation; probably some cheap vegetable, perhaps a bulbous root:--dove's dung.

H1687.et: from (01696) (apparently in the sense of oracle)
H1687.def: or (shortened) dbir {deb-eer'}; from «01696» (apparently in the sense of oracle); the shrine or innermost part of the sanctuary:--oracle.

H1688.def: or (shortened) Dbir (Josh. 13:26 (but see «03810»)) {deb-eer'}; the same as «01687»; Debir, the name of an Amoritish king and of two places in Palestine:--Debir.

H1689.def: probably an orthographical error for «07247»; Diblah, a place in Syria:--Diblath.

H1690.def: from an unused root (akin to «02082») probably meaning to press together; a cake of pressed figs:--cake (lump) of figs.

H1691.def: dual from the masculine of «01690»; two cakes; Diblajim, a symbolic name:--Diblaim.

H1692.def: a primitive root; properly, to impinge, i.e. cling or adhere; figuratively, to catch by pursuit:--abide fast, cleave (fast together), follow close (hard after), be joined (together), keep (fast), overtake, pursue hard, stick, take.

H1694.def: from «01692»; a joint; by implication, solder:--joint, solder.

H1696.def: a primitive root; perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue:--answer, appoint, bid, command, commune, declare, destroy, give, name, promise, pronounce, rehearse, say, speak, be spokesman, subdue, talk, teach, tell, think, use (entreaties), utter, × well, × work.

H1697.def: from «01696»; a word; by implication, a matter (as spoken of) or thing; adverbially, a cause:--act, advice, affair, answer, × any such (thing), because of, book, business, care, case, cause, certain rate, + chronicles, commandment, × commune(-ication), + concern(-ing), + confer, counsel, + dearth, decree, deed, × disease, due, duty, effect, + eloquent, errand, (evil favoured-)ness, + glory, + harm, hurt, + iniquity, + judgment, language, + lying, manner, matter, message, (no) thing, oracle, × ought, × parts, + pertaining, + please, portion, + power, promise, provision, purpose, question, rate, reason, report, request, × (as hast) said, sake, saying, sentence, + sign, + so, some (uncleanness)

H1698.def: from «01696» (in the sense of destroying); a pestilence:--murrain, pestilence, plague.

H1699.def: from «01696» (in its original sense); a pasture (from its arrangement of the flock):--fold, manner.
